dependencies.detail: Synapse, MAS, local PostgreSQL and Nginx gateway share one VM; Synapse/MAS bind loopback.

SOPS generators render runtime Synapse/MAS/bridge configs and coordinate rotation; signing/encryption identity needs explicit authorization.
Matrix-compatible host publication reaches Nginx; federation, SMTP and WhatsApp egress require independent acceptance.

storageNotes: All proposed state PVCs are fresh and blank; source images/mounts are provenance only.
Legacy /persist identity/credentials are not copied; the fresh retained root holds new guest OS state until a per-service identity design is approved.
External media/NFS/virtiofs paths are not mounted by groundwork.
Sizes mirror declared budgets, not observed usage. Review free space, filesystem overhead and restore needs before resuming storage.
